summary: Phase 3 presentation work: preserve the Accounting presentation implementation in source while resetting every authenticated internal route to a clean blank white rebuild surface, keeping canonical routes, shell navigation, APIs, permissions, backend/domain modules, and business logic intact.
protectedReason: Phase 3 intentionally changes canonical presentation owners. Accounting styling remains scoped in canonical styles.css, while the requested whole-system clean reset must occur at AppShell so former route pages are disconnected from rendering rather than hidden, overlaid, duplicated, or deleted. Backend, API, route registry, permissions, and business/domain ownership remain unchanged.
